notes: The same Claude Code agent (claude-code@2.1.330, anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5) runs on both sides over the same raw trajectory.jsonl with a 1800 s timeout per episode. Harbor side: the standard claude-code agent on Harbor 0.27.0 with the separate verifier (ama-bench_parity_claude_code_alfworld.yaml). Original side: AMA-Bench at commit d2d5715 with --method claude_code. Both sides are graded by claude-haiku-4-5 through Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (temperature 0, max_tokens 2048). Subset alfworld-10: 10 alfworld episodes (EMBODIED_AI, ids 30-39), 120 graded QAs per run. 3 runs per side. Metric is mean_judge_score (the paper's avg_score). All trials completed on the first attempt with no agent errors, retries or judge failures. Run-score ranges overlap: Harbor [0.517, 0.558] vs original [0.533, 0.583].
